senses.gloss: m., constr. <cite ref="I00596"><he>טְעוּן</he></cite> (<he>טְעַן</he> II, v. <cite ref="I00185"><he>טוּנָא</he> I</cite>)

units: Targ. I Sam. XVI, 20 ט׳ חמרא ט׳ דלחמא ed. Lag. (oth. ed. טעין דלחמא) an ass-load consisting of a load (or bag, v. infra) of bread and &c.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 5:17">Targ. II Kings V, 17</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 32a">Ib. 32ᵃ</cite> … <he>וטְעוּנַיְּיהוּ וכ׳ דרמי</he> when they themselves and their loads lie on the road.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Joshua 2:6">Targ. Josh. II, 6</cite> <he>ט׳ כיתנא</he> bags of flax.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 2:1:20">Y. Dem. II, 22ᵈ</cite>, contrad. to <cite ref="A03339"><he>אַשְׁפְּלָה</he></cite>. Lam. R. introd. (R. Joh. 1) <he>מובלי ט׳ דחלא</he> loads of bags of sand.
